# Unipheas — Brian Phillips

> Independent software and AI engineering consulting for companies with an active product, technical sponsor, and defined delivery needs.

Brian Phillips has more than 15 years across mobile, full-stack development, and software systems. Clients work directly with Brian. Services include AI development workflows, delivery automation, mobile engineering, software audits, and ongoing technical partnerships.

## Fees (USD)
- General consulting: $350/hour, with scope and expected effort agreed.
- Engineering Rescue Audit: $12,500 fixed for agreed scope, planned over 2–3 weeks after access is ready. Findings and a 90-day roadmap; implementation excluded.
- Foundation implementation: $45,000–$75,000 planning range; final scope and fee quoted.
- Ongoing partnership: $4,000–$8,000/month planning range; capacity and support boundaries defined in writing. Not unlimited or 24/7 coverage.
